title: dsh-evolve-le run configuration
description: Versioned configuration frozen into the run manifest at PREFLIGHT (specs/06 §2, specs/07 §7). One config drives one run lineage; the stable-demo default is K=3, no sealed access, at most 15 solver trials (specs/03 §2). Credentials are never inlined: model routes reference external root-readable files (CLAUDE.md rule 8).

runId.description: Fresh per run; never reused across run directories.

profile.description: stable-demo proves stable iteration only and never enters the champion tournament; terminal-bench-formal runs the full ADR-045..049 protocol (benchmark baseline, tournament + champion lock, sealed pre-registration).

candidateProtocol.description: Candidate lineage contract. tree-v2 creates a non-inheriting migration receipt before fresh evaluation.

masterSeed.description: Master seed commitment source for every RNG stream (split, scheduler-thompson, task-sampler).

modelRoutes.description: Frozen route table; route identity (including the compatible Zen/high/1M/131k route) is content-hashed into the run manifest and every gateway receipt.

proposerRoute.description: The model route id the proposal sandbox runs behind.

solverRoute.description: Optional live model route id for SOLVE trials (ADR-030). Absent means every solve trial runs the recorded-replay capsule (Gate 8 behavior). Must reference a zen-compatible networked route and be paired with budget.solverTokens; the derived track (self iff it equals proposerRoute, specs/00 §4) and route hash freeze into the run manifest.

nativeDsh.description: Trusted prebuilt DSH catalog and preflight closure hash. The built-in iteration builder requires this lock and rechecks it for every candidate admission.

sealedAccess.description: stable-demo never touches sealed tasks; the field exists so a future profile must state it explicitly, not silently default.

masterSeed.description: High-entropy secret kept out of evidence; only sha256(seed||dataset||protocol) commitments are recorded.

catalogRoot.description: Absolute path to the vetted, prebuilt DSH source catalog. It is TCB configuration, never candidate input.

dependencyClosureSha256.description: SHA-256 of the effective native DSH dependency closure assembled by preflight.

kTarget.description: K: admitted non-baseline candidates target (specs/03 §2); stable-demo default 3.

proposalWidth.description: W_p: independent children requested per expansion; default 3.

coldStartTrials.description: q0: forced cold-start trials per admitted node; default 1.

ucbAirAlphaPerMille.description: UCB-Air exponent in per-mille (600 = 0.6); frozen for the run.

shortlistSize.description: Final development tournament size; recorded but unused by stable-demo.

maxSolverTrials.description: Hard cap on completed development agent-task trials for this profile. The stable demo (specs/07 §7) allows at most 15; Gate 8 benchmark profiles (specs/07 §10, e.g. pilot K=10, formal K=80) pre-register their own larger caps that must still fund discovery plus every admitted child's q0 cold starts (semantic check in run-config.ts).

discoveryBatchSize.description: Observed tasks per discovery batch before re-checking for failures (specs/04 §4.1: first batch 6, second batch 6 when the first shows no failure, hard cap 12 total). K always counts admitted candidates (specs/03 §2), never the discovery sample size.

taskCount.description: Observed tasks in the frozen benchmark baseline matrix (specs/04 §4.2, ADR-042); bounded by the development split. ADR-049: the maximum is 49 — the formal K=80 matrix is the full ≤1800s-eligible development population (39 observed + 10 guard); a larger matrix is a schema violation.

attemptsPerTask.description: Baseline attempts per task (specs/04 §4.2 requires at least 2 for the formal K=80 matrix; K=10 pre-registers 1).

batchSize.description: Wave-scheduling batch width; a partial final batch is legal (ADR-042).

benchmarkBaseline.description: Pre-registered benchmark baseline freeze (specs/04 §4.2, ADR-042): when present the driver replaces stable-demo discovery (specs/04 §4.1) with the full matrix — the first taskCount observed handles in frozen ceremony order, attemptsPerTask attempts each — and freezes the pool of zero-success tasks only after every matrix trial produced a real outcome. Absent = stable-demo discovery.

minEligibilityTrials.description: Minimum committed observations per eligible node (specs/03 §11, default 12).

coverageAttemptsPerTask.description: Tournament coverage attempts per development task (specs/03 §11, default 1).

maxTrials.description: Tournament trial budget (ADR-047: 360 for the formal run; top-up + coverage must both fit or the run stops NO_DEVELOPMENT_IMPROVEMENT).

bootstrapResamples.description: Cluster-bootstrap resamples for the 90% LCB (ADR-047: fixed seed, at least 100000).

tournament.description: Champion tournament envelope (ADR-047). Optional for stable-demo (which never enters the tournament); required by the terminal-bench-formal profile (semantic check in run-config.ts).

provider.description: zen-compatible preserves the DeepSeek Zen-compatible Chat Completions route shape (high reasoning, 1M context, 131k output).

inputUsdMicrosPerMTok.description: Frozen price in micro-USD per million prompt tokens.

credentialFile.description: Absolute path to a mode-0600 root-readable credential file; required for zen-compatible routes, forbidden to appear anywhere else (CLAUDE.md rule 8).

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (.../v1); required when this route is the proposerRoute.

model.description: Exact upstream model id, frozen into the route plan hash and every remote receipt.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature locked by the TCB proxy on every outbound request.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the first (ADR-033); 1 disables retrying. Required for zen-compatible routes and frozen into the route plan hash.

backoffMs.description: Delay before attempt i+1; length must equal maxAttempts - 1.

retry.description: ADR-033 frozen retry policy: how many attempts one chat completion gets and the inter-attempt delays. Retryable classes are fixed by the shared upstream core (5xx, network failure), not by this document.

maxAgentTimeoutSec.description: Only tasks whose Terminal-Bench [agent].timeout_sec is at most 1800 seconds are eligible for K=10, K=80, and final evaluation.

tasksRoot.description: Directory of materialized pinned task directories (content-verified by preflight against the dataset pin).

baselineSourceDir.description: Lineage-root candidate package the trusted builder admits.

legacyBaselineSourceDir.description: Legacy-v1 source identity bound by the tree-v2 migration receipt; required only when candidateProtocol is tree-v2.

trialContainerProxy.description: ADR-028 second amendment: optional HTTP proxy injected into every trial container's environment (jobconfig env lever) so the pre-launch ACP apt bootstrap can use the host's fast egress path. No credentials; recorded verbatim in every job plan YAML.

usd.description: Total run budget in USD micros.

solverTokens.description: Total live-solver token budget across the run (ADR-030); required iff solverRoute is set. Reserved per trial before launch and settled from the gateway receipt chain — never from agent self-reporting.

wallClockMinutes.description: The wall-clock objective is 16h for the formal protocol (specs/00 §6.3), NOT a system invariant for every config. The 48h bound admits pre-registered rehearsal profiles whose live trials cannot fit 16h (ADR-030 K=10 live pilot: ~50 live Harbor trials at minutes-to-half-an-hour each) — the deviation must be recorded in the run's STATUS preRegistration. ADR-045 explicitly amends the formal K=80 objective to 30h (1800 minutes) with full disclosure: the mandatory trial floor (98 baseline + 240 cold starts + tournament + sealed) cannot fit 16h at the observed 1447s/trial-slot pace.
